name: @gofastr/scanner-bundle
description: In-frame barcode scanner bundle for the GoFastr scanner plugin. Builds a single IIFE (@zxing/library) that runs inside the opaque-origin sandboxed iframe and speaks protocol v1 to the host over postMessage: the camera is unreachable from an opaque origin, so the HOST captures and pushes grayscale scanFrame events across the bridge, the cage decodes with zxing and answers every frame with a frameDone ack — one frame in flight, the ack is the flow control. Pure JS decode, no wasm, no network.
